title: Decide whether the ride can start
prompt: `paid` and `closed` are supplied bools, and `riders` is a supplied whole number. Declare a bool named `ready`. It is true only when the tickets are paid, the ride is not closed, and there are more than 0 riders.
hints: How many separate facts must all be true?
Join facts that must all hold with &&. Flip closed with !.
Combine paid, !closed and riders > 0 with && in one expression.
checkLabels: ready must be true only when the tickets are paid, the ride is not closed and there are more than 0 riders.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses or where every condition must hold.

feedback: Take the failing case and work out each of the three facts on its own. ready is true only when all three are true.
